questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if

it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the

statements.

Statements:

Some eagles are sparrows.

All sparrows are parrots.

No parrot is a penguin.

Conclusions:

(I) Some parrots are eagles.

(II) No penguin is a sparrow.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/558e1f127d646426f8f416539d728f2ffab393024cd9edcf55addc5b45d0a295.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some parrots are eagles → Follow (As some eagles are sparrows and all sparrows are parrots. As some part of eagles is common with sparrows which whole comes in parrots, therefore it is true.)

II. No penguin is a sparrow → Follow (As all sparrows are parrots and no parrot is a penguin. As whole sparrows comes in parrots which cannot be penguin, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d45ec7307ecb9f209a43dfdcdad89d1e7720e2d9f3b1fba59d42b22b190194ac.png]
questions.solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Total triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2

= [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2

= [2 × 3] ÷ 2

= 6 ÷ 2

= 3

As there are 4 same types of triangles, therefore total number of triangles will be (3 × 4) = 12 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a02aee5bfad1ef62885c7d60fc3318a22894633c903a2db28da1ba49f2ea230.png]

Thus, there are total (12 + 3) = 15 triangles.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 20 + 10 × 2 − 4 ÷ 5 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 20 - __**10 ÷ 2**__ + 4 × 5 = ?

⇒ 20 - 5 +__** 4 **____**× **____**5**__ = ?

⇒ **__20__** - 5 + __**20**__ = ?

⇒ **40 - 5 = 35**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:

Logic: **Synonyms**

Here,

**Wander** : **Ramble** → **Wander** is a synonym of **Ramble**.

Similarly,

questions.question:
The same operation(s) are followed in all the given number pairs except one. Find that odd number pair.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: (Second Number × 6) + 1 = First Number

Option 1) 19 : 3

__**(3 × 6)**__ + 1 = 19

__**18 + 1**__ = 19

19 = 19 (LHS = RHS)

Option 2) 55 : 9

__(9 × 6)__ + 1 = 55

__54 + 1__ = 55

55 = 55 (LHS = RHS)

Option 3) 49 : 8

__(8 × 6)__ + 1 = 49

__48 + 1__ = 49

49 = 49 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4) 24 : 4

__(4 × 6)__ + 1 = 24

__24 + 1__ = 24

25 ≠ 24 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options '24 : 4' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
